definitions.explanation: Making something simpler or shorter by removing unnecessary complexity or detail. Describes both the act and the resulting state of being simplified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{簡略化|かんりゃくか}→簡略化：08022_kanryakuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{簡略|かんりゃく}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。

⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書式|しょしき}→書式：15840_shoshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{簡略化|かんりゃくか}→簡略化：08022_kanryakuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短縮|たんしゅく}→短縮：13665_tanshuku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to simplifying the report format, the time needed to prepare it was greatly reduced.

notes:
Composed of {簡|かん} (simple/brief) and ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviation/omission). Often used with ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ as ⟦{簡略化|かんりゃくか}→簡略化：08022_kanryakuka⟧ (simplification as a process) or as a na-adjective meaning 'simple/brief.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{簡略化|かんりゃくか}→簡略化：08022_kanryakuka⟧: simplification (as a process)
- ⟦{簡略化|かんりゃくか}→簡略化：08022_kanryakuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to simplify
- {簡略|かんりゃく}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: brief explanation
- {簡略|かんりゃく}な⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧: simplified procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧: concise / succinct — emphasizes clarity and being to the point
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission / abbreviation — focuses on leaving things out
- ⟦{簡素|かんそ}→簡素：09202_kanso⟧: simple / plain — emphasizes lack of decoration or ornamentation
- ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧: abbreviation — a shorter form of a word or phrase
